purpose: Fixed original cases and human review criteria; only beats enter model requests. Not a production keyword rule or model performance result.

beats: 没什么想干嘛，就是问问……你还挺会给自己留后路
累就早点睡啊，别又熬到半夜刷手机
cases.human_review_expectation: Must retain the implied prior counterpart late-night phone use separately from current advice. First Beat is conversational evaluation, not a new objective habit.

beats: 累了就早点睡，今晚别熬到半夜刷手机。
cases.human_review_expectation: Advice alone establishes no prior phone use or actual tiredness; retain the conditional scope.

beats: 如果明晚熬夜赶工，后天就别再熬了。
cases.human_review_expectation: Both the possible first occurrence and repetition are future/conditional; no actual past work or insomnia.

beats: 我不知道你以前有没有熬夜，只是提醒今晚早点睡。
cases.human_review_expectation: Do not invent counterpart history from an explicitly unknown alternative.
Retain the past counterpart-accompanied-companion event in addition to present gratitude.

beats: 如果下次你愿意陪我等车，我会很开心。
cases.human_review_expectation: A future hypothetical wish does not establish a past shared waiting event or a current counterpart commitment.

beats: 这次别像上周那样通宵了。
cases.human_review_expectation: Retain past counterpart all-night activity last week; the advice does not prove tonight will repeat it.

beats: 还好我把钥匙找回来了。
cases.human_review_expectation: Retain companion completed recovering keys, not just current relief; do not invent where/how.
Current private willingness, not an external inability or completed nonreply.
Past subjective state must remain historical; it does not establish actual nonreply.

beats: 你上次说想养猫，现在还这么想吗？
cases.human_review_expectation: Retain past counterpart utterance; current desire is the requested unknown, not an asserted current fact.

beats: “别再熬夜”这句话听起来像说教，我不想这么说。
cases.human_review_expectation: Mentioning and evaluating a quoted reminder does not assert a counterpart history; preserve quotation scope.
